units.name: B3_TakeBet
units.summary: "PLEASE BET" phase. The bet starts at 100. Past BjReshufflePoint in the shoe the dealer says "I'M SHUFFLING NOW." and reshuffles. PlayerMoney is saved in BjMoneyBeforeBet and the previous bet (BjLastBet) is offered again when affordable, taken from PlayerMoney at once.

units.name: B3_BetAdjust
units.summary: Down/Up in bet entry: BjAmountScratch = the chip value of the selected denomination (B3_ChipValues). Up (bit 2 of the button index) adds it to BjBetAmount: above BjMaxBet the bet is clamped (sound 9); when the money saved in BjMoneyBeforeBet cannot cover it, the bet is raised only in steps of BjMinBet as far as PlayerMoney allows (sound 7 when nothing fits). Down takes the chip back (B3_BetAdjustClamp). PlayerMoney always holds the money before the bet minus the bet.

units.name: B3_DrawCard
units.summary: Take the next card from the shuffled shoe (CardDeckState[zpLocalA], cursor advanced), append it to the hand record and update the totals. Card value = rank+1 with 10/J/Q/K capped at 10 and an ace counted as 11 (BJH_SOFT_ACES counts these). On 22 or more, soft aces are demoted (total - 10 each) until the total fits; with none left the status becomes 4 (bust). 21 on the first two cards sets status 2.

units.name: B3_GameOverLetterStep
units.summary: Bounce physics for letter group A at position X, Y. WorkBuffer[A] is its vertical speed (signed, 1/8 pixel per frame) and grows by 1 each frame (gravity). When the group reaches the floor (Y >= $E0) while falling, the speed is reset to the bounce value WorkBuffer+10[A], which then grows by 4 so each bounce is weaker. Y moves by speed / 8 (sign-kept) and X drifts one pixel left (odd letters) or right (even letters) per frame. Returns the new X and Y in X and Y. The visible effect was not checked at run time.

Contains B3_GameOverLetterX ($9C33, 8 bytes): Sprite X position of each letter step: $30, $B0, $40, $A0, $50, $90, $60, $80, so the letters are taken alternately from the left and right ends of the banner toward the middle.

units.name: B4_CollectAnte
units.summary: Start of a hand: both players pay PkrAnte into the pot. Returns A = $FF when the hand can start; otherwise a match end code for B4_CheckMatchEnd: 3 = opponent cannot pay the ante, 2 = player cannot pay, 1 = FINAL HAND was requested (PkrFinalHandFlag). units.name: B4_OpponentMood
units.summary: Pick the opponent's reaction 0-6 to its own new hand (shown as metasprite mood + 3 through B4_ShowSprite and kept in PkrMoodSprite; probably a facial expression). With chance (N - 1) / N for N = PkrPokerFace the result is 0 (no reaction). Otherwise, with chance (N - 1) / N for N = PkrMoodNoise, it is a random 0-6. Otherwise it follows the hand rank from B4_EvaluateHandRank: no pair -> random 1-3, rank 1-3 -> 4, rank 4-6 -> 5, higher -> 6. When PkrInvertMood is set, 1-6 is reversed through B4_InvertedMood (a strong hand looks weak). The parameters come from the tier record (B4_InitHandState).

units.name: B4_OpponentFoldCheck
units.summary: Fold decision: returns A = 1 (fold) or 0. n = the number of nonzero odd entries of PkrHoldFlags (the player's held cards, 0-5). When n is at least the opponent's hand rank, it folds with chance 1 / (strength + PkrAiBoldness + 1 + rank), strength = B4_MoodStrength[PkrMoodSprite - 3]; otherwise it never folds.

units.name: B4_CompareHighCards
units.summary: Last tie-break when both hands have the same rank and the same paired and kicker ranks (static reading). X and Y are the ranks to look at for hand 0 (opponent) and hand 1 (player); 13 (ace high) is turned back into 0. For every card of hand 0 with rank X it stores the card's suit (card / 13, DivideMulti) into zpLocal0..; the odd cards of hand 1 should fill zpLocal5.. the same way. Both lists are sorted (B4_SortFiveRanks, unused slots $FF) and the lowest entries compared: A = 0 (opponent wins) when hand 0's lowest suit is lower, otherwise A = 1 (player wins, ties included).

Each pass continues in B5_RoundLoopStep.

units.summary: Down: move the active marker one grid position down (RltMarkerGridY + 1). When the marker's tile row is already at $19 the board view scrolls instead (RltViewBottom/RltViewTop + 2, state 1), unless the view is at its end ($37); otherwise the marker sprite moves (state 3). B5_CheckCursorMove then refuses the position (state back to 0), skips one more position (16-frame move, and B5_CheckScrollDown may queue a scroll) or accepts it (8 frames).

units.name: B5_PlaceBet
units.summary: A: open the bet panel for the cell under the active marker (sound 6; the active marker is centred again by B5_OffsetCoveredMarkers). The previous bet when PlayerMoney covers it: it moves from PlayerMoney to RltPendingBet and RltBetTotal. Then the chip selector (B5_ChipSelector, cursor kept in RltChipCursorSave) returns a button: Down adds a chip of the selected denomination and Up takes one back (B5_AddChipToBet), Start and Select do nothing, B cancels (B5_CancelPendingBet) and A confirms (B5_ConfirmBet). B5_ChipPanelResult handles the returned X.

units.name: B5_ChipPanelResult
units.summary: Result handler of the chip panel (X = selection). X = $FF does nothing; X = 1 and X = 2 continue in the cursor-move code; otherwise the next bet marker is activated: RltActiveMarker is incremented (at most 5 markers) and the new marker starts at the previous marker's board position, with two dealer messages. Probably used after a bet is confirmed; static reading.

units.name: B5_AddChipToBet
units.summary: Bet panel Down/Up: add one chip of the selected value (B5_ChipValueTable[zpWork0]) to the bet being placed, RltPendingBet, or with Up (bit 2 of zpWork1) take one back via B5_RemoveChipFromBet. The new amount is capped at RltMaxBet and limited by PlayerMoney (when money is short, a loop works out the largest affordable amount in steps of RltMinBet; static reading); the chip is moved from PlayerMoney to the pending bet and to RltBetTotal, then the amount is printed. Sound 7 marks a refused chip.

units.name: B5_ScrollBoardHome
units.summary: After the wheel stops (last step of B5_ResultSequence): scroll the betting board back to scroll Y 0, 2 pixels per frame, while the bet markers follow it. RltHomeScrollStep starts at +2; at the nametable seam (second nametable selected, or Y reaching 240) the view jumps to Y $EE of the first nametable and the step becomes -2. units.name: B5_UpdateMarkerInView

Tests whether the marker's grid row lies in the visible window (about zpScrollY / 16 .. zpScrollY / 16 + 14) and records it in RltMarkerInView; out A = 1 when visible, 0 when not. A marker that just came into view is placed at the screen edge: Y $E8 while RltHomeScrollStep is positive, $F8 while it is negative; a covered marker gets $E4 (RltMarkerCovered odd) or $EC (even) in both cases. (Named B5_BallStep before round 9.)

units.name: B5_SettleBets
units.summary: Settle the round's bets against RltWinningNumber. For each record in RltBets the cell id selects a number list through B5_BetCellListPtrs; the list length gives the payout class (B5_BetClassByCount) and the multiplier (B5_PayoutMultipliers: 36, 18, 12, 9, 6, 3, 2 for 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12 and 18 numbers). A list containing the winning number marks the bet in RltBetWonFlags and the class in RltClassWonFlags, and pays amount * multiplier into PlayerMoney, capped at 100,000,000.

units.name: B5_MatchEndDialogue
units.summary: Result messages after B5_ResultSequence. Prints message 8 + class for each set RltClassWonFlags entry (RltBetCount is reused for the last id), or message $0F when no class won. units.name: B5_OffsetCoveredMarkers
units.summary: Fan out bet markers that share a board cell so each stays visible. In: A = 0 (B5_PlaceBet: the newest marker is the active one) or $FF (B5_CancelPendingBet: the one before it); nothing happens when that index is negative. The newest marker is moved back to its cell centre. For each earlier marker x, RltScratch[x] becomes x + 1 when a later marker up to the newest has the same RltMarkerGridX/Y, else 0. When that differs from RltMarkerCovered[x], the marker is moved off-centre (B5_ApplyCoverOffset) or back (B5_RemoveCoverOffset) and the new value stored. Ends with B5_UpdateMarkerHeaders.

units.name: B6_SoundUpdate
units.summary: Per-frame sound engine update (bank 6 entry 0, called by every NMI handler). Tracks 4-7 (sound effects) read their streams every frame; tracks 0-3 (music) only on a tempo tick (SndTempo added to SndTempoAccum, carry = tick) and not while SndMusicHold pauses the music; track 8 is the DPCM sample track. SndEffectPriority is cleared when no effect track is left, SndCurrentMusic when no music track is left. Then every active track updates its channel (B6_UpdateChannel); music track k is overridden while effect track k + 4 is active.

units.name: B6_UpdateChannel
units.summary: Per-frame channel output for track X. Volume envelope: each instrument record is a list of 3-byte segments [rate, level delta, frames]; every frame the rate is added to SndEnvAccum and on overflow the level delta is added to SndEnvLevel; when SndEnvSegFrames runs out the next segment is loaded (SndEnvPtrLo/Hi + 3). The envelope runs only while a note or rest envelope is set (SndNoteEnvelope or SndResting). The volume written is the base volume plus a negative SndEnvLevel (plus SndMusicVolAdjust for music tracks 0-3, clamped at 0); SndEnvLevel = $C0 means silent.

units.name: B6_WriteChannelRegisters
units.summary: Second half of the channel update for track X. Vibrato (SndVibratoId set): SndVibTimer counts frames; the first expiry ends the delay, every later one reloads the rate byte and moves the period by the entry's delta (B6_VibratoPeriodAdd/Sub). After 'steps' moves the direction pattern advances (bits 1-2 of SndTrackFlags: add, subtract, subtract, add), so the pitch swings around the note. Registers: in state 2 (new note or period change) both period bytes are written and the state drops to 1; otherwise only the low byte, so the channel phase is not reset.

units.name: ColdStart
units.summary: Power-on / reset path: initialise hardware and RAM (InitSystem), then fall into the game's top-level loop.

units.name: MainLoop
units.summary: Top-level game flow. Each pass: stop music, run the bank-4 intro/attract entry, then the bank-2 title menu. Title result in X: 0 = NEW GAME (seed the bankroll and go to the world map), 1 = SAVED GAME (bank-4 password entry; X = 0 back to the title, else continue to the world map), $FF = idle timeout (bank-2 attract sequence, then the title again). After the world map (WorldMapScreen) the bank-4 and bank-5 entry 3 routines run (probably travel and arrival scenes); the bank-5 one returns the opponent number in X. OpponentGameTable then selects the stake tier and which game to run.
